affine_layout.note: An affine transform [a, b, c, d, e, f] maps (x, y) to (a*x + c*y + e, b*x + d*y + f).

alignment_bytes.note: Payload sections of envelope binaries start on this boundary.

alpha_mode.note: Colour samples are NOT premultiplied by alpha.

angle_direction.note: Angles grow counter-clockwise as seen on screen (towards 12 o'clock), although y grows downward.

angle_zero.note: Angle 0 points along the positive x axis (3 o'clock).

cmyk_zero.note: CMYK components are ink amounts: 0.0 is no ink, 1.0 is full ink.

endianness.note: Every envelope binary is little-endian. MessagePack header integers inside an envelope are big-endian by MessagePack's own definition (spec/layouts/ENVELOPE.layout.txt section 4).

float_format.note: 32-bit samples are IEEE-754 binary32, little-endian, whatever the section's dtype label says.

gray_zero.note: A gray sample of 0.0 is black, 1.0 is white.

hash_algorithm.note: Every files[].sha256, every input_hash, license.sha256, and spec_sha256.

lab_ab_scale.note: Lab a and b: a* = 255 * value - 128 (and b* likewise).

layer_order.note: Entry 0 of a layer list is the bottom layer, drawn first.

length_unit.note: Every length and position is in document pixels unless a field name ends in _pt.

mask_zero.note: A mask, selection or channel value of 0.0 hides / is unselected, 1.0 reveals / is selected.

pixel_origin.note: Pixel (0, 0) is the canvas's top-left pixel; integer coordinate (x, y) names the pixel whose top-left corner is at (x, y).

points_per_inch.note: Fields ending in _pt are typographic points: pixels = points * resolution_dpi / 72.

preview_color_space.note: Preview PNGs are 8-bit sRGB with straight alpha.

sample_layout.note: The samples of one pixel are stored together, in the order of the header's `channels`.

signature_algorithm.note: SIGNATURE.json only. Refusing it is the 'unverified' state, not damage.

text_encoding.note: Every text and JSON payload, INCLUDING MANIFEST.json - which is why the scope is container.

text_run_unit.note: Text run lengths count UTF-8 bytes of the layer's text.

tile_scan_order.note: Inside a tile, rows run top to bottom and pixels left to right.

tile_size_px.note: A tile is 256 x 256 pixels. Tile (tx, ty) covers x in [256*tx, 256*tx + 256), y in [256*ty, 256*ty + 256); tx and ty may be negative.

white_f32.note: 32-bit float samples are the value itself: 1.0 is white, values outside 0..1 are legal.

y_axis.note: y grows DOWNWARD. Row 0 of a tile is its top row.

note: The machine-readable convention to node-type map of profile raster-layers/1 (SPEC.md section 10.2, ruling S-17). The convention set is a property of the PROFILE, not of the reader (S-25): check these and no others.
